title: 18161 - 18161/P1753
models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Gear position (PRINDLE) positions on dash are all illuminated
Transmission will not shift manually when slid into the +/-  selection
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  wiring and connections according as per wiring diagram(s)
Kontrol edin:  Tiptronic Recognition Measuring Blocks. (MB 002 on 01J trans)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the Audi A4/S4/RS4/Cabriolet (8E/8H) CVT 6-Speed Automatic Transmission (01J/Multitronic):
Kontrol edin:  adjustment of selector lever cable as per repair manual.
